description: This file is a Flutter main entry point for the app, defining the main widget hierarchy including a stateless MyApp class and a stateful MyHomePage class displaying a simple loading UI.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: Root widget that sets up the MaterialApp with theme and home page.

classes.name: MyHomePage
classes.description: Stateful widget representing the home page with a title property.

classes.name: _MyHomePageState
classes.description: State class managing the build method for MyHomePage, displaying a progress UI.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Application entry point, runs the MyApp widget.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Build method for MyApp and _MyHomePageState, responsible for rendering UI.
